semantics.clock: All state updates at positive edge of clk
semantics.history: previous input is sampled on every positive edge, including reset edges
semantics.transition: For each bit i, falling[i] = previous_sample[i] AND NOT current_in[i]
semantics.output: At each positive edge, reset=1 clears out to zero with priority; otherwise out becomes old out OR falling
semantics.persistence: Captured bits remain set until a rising edge with reset high
semantics.initialization: No power-up initialization specified. Output is defined after synchronous reset; history is defined after one sampled edge.
semantics.between_edges: out holds its value; reset and in changes alone do not update state

numeric.operations: Bitwise NOT, AND and OR only; no arithmetic, rounding, overflow or saturation

verification.oracle: Independent per-bit scoreboard storing previous sampled bit and sticky captured bit
directed: each of 32 falling edges captures corresponding bit
input sampled during reset used on following cycle
between-edge input and reset changes do not affect output
verification.random: 1000 randomized input samples with intermittent synchronous reset
verification.tools: Icarus v12 compile with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top; compile and vvp each bounded by timeout; independent simulation watchdog

specification_ambiguities.resolution: Reset explicitly clears capture output only; input history continues sampling each clock, preserving definition of consecutive-cycle transition.
Unspecified; no initial values added, tests establish state by synchronous reset.
